invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破93.0（基于ATR上移和支撑），或融资费率Z-score升至50%以上（风险增加）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 93.0 (based on ATR move-up and support), or funding Z-score rises above 50% (risk increases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破73200（基于日线支撑和ATR），或融资费率Z-score回落至0%以下（风险缓解但需监控）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 73200 (based on daily support and ATR), or funding Z-score falls below 0% (risk eases but monitor).
